title: Wet Well Cleaning
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND > AIR FORCE LIFE CYCLE MANAGEMENT CENTER > FA2835 AFLCMC HANSCOM PZI
description:
Hanscom AFB requires temporary wastewater hauling capabilities to prevent sanitary sewer overflows (SSOs), maintain environmental compliance, and support operational continuity during lift station pump failure, replacement. The objective is to main tain wet well liquid levels at safe operating thresholds continuously until primary pumping system is restored. 

 Please see the attached PWS and Cover Letter for more information.
